calls.summary:
# Jon Thompson and James Shannon
Date: 2026-10-29 | Duration: 14.59000015258789m

## Summary
Monument Technology is evaluating GrowthBook to replace increasingly difficult-to-manage, platform-specific feature-flag approaches across its banking-platform SaaS operations for building societies and banks. The initial priority is feature flags, while product analytics and experimentation may be considered later. A self-serve model is favored because the internal engineering team can manage implementation, although onboarding, training, engineering Slack access, and customer success are included in the enterprise package. Self-hosting is strongly preferred for infrastructure control, firewall protection, maintainability, and possible Middle East data-residency requirements; cloud deployment could introduce CDN-request metering. GrowthBook supports multiple separated customer instances, role separation, SSO, audit trails, and no identified active-user limitation. Enterprise pricing starts at $50,000 annually, with seats at $1,000 each; 12 seats would total $62,000 at list price with full support. Removing support reduces the license price by 30%, and no minimum seat count was identified. Monument wants to decide soon, ahead of an early-next-year first customer launch, with John expected to confirm by email.

## Keywords
Feature flags, Self-hosting, Banking SaaS, Data residency, Enterprise pricing, Product analytics

## Action Items

Send email confirming GrowthBook decision (13:02)
